name: Kanagawa Chuo Kotsu Co., Ltd.
summary: Kanagawa Chuo Kotsu Co., Ltd. engages in passenger car transportation, real estate, and automobile sales businesses in Japan. The company is involved in the charter bus and taxi businesses; sale of condominiums, brokerage, buy-and-resell, and rental activities; and sale of trucks and buses, as well as provision of after-sales services for customers in a variety of industries and sectors.
